a.lede: Amazon Web Services logged attempts to leverage the internet-melting PHP2Shell bugs four days ago. They're now being “broadly exploited” across the internet.
a.title: Hackers Exploited the PHP Vulnerabilities Days Before They Were Patched

b.lede: The PHP security team released emergency security patches for two critical remote code execution (RCE) vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619) tracked collectively as PHP2Shell. [...]
b.title: PHP ships emergency patches for critical PHP2Shell flaws
